description: KS-06-01 AC6: collecting SPEED at 0:31 keeps it active until 0:26, across the 0:30 warning. startTick jumps the round clock to one step before collection (see powerups.test.js's loadReplay) instead of simulating the 58+ leading seconds tick by tick; initialPickup seeds the one power-up P1's next step walks onto. No input is needed — P1 is already heading straight at the pickup.
